flags.message: The staged decision-below.txt is the original September 8, 2025 opinion, not the controlling March 6, 2026 amended opinion. The lower-court-docket.txt rehearing excerpt stops in November 2025 and reports no disposition or dissent found. The official petition appendix supplies the amended opinion, rehearing denial, and eight-judge dissent; forecast relies on that appendix instead. Not blocking.
